mapper.select: SELECT Pos, Variant, Ya, HP, JP, LR, MJ, RU, YR FROM ${tableName} WHERE pos LIKE CONCAT(#{chr}, ':%') AND CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(pos, ':', -1) AS UNSIGNED) BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT gene_id as geneId, chr, start - #{upstream} as startExtend, end + #{downstream} as endExtend FROM gene_coords WHERE gene_id = #{geneId}
SELECT CHROM, POS, YavsMJ, YavsHP, YavsJP, YavsRU, HPvsRU, HPvsJP, YavsLR, YavsYR FROM fst_result WHERE CHROM = #{chr} AND POS BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY POS ASC
SELECT CHROM, POS, YR, LR, Ya, MJ, HP, JP, RU FROM pi_result WHERE CHROM = #{chr} AND POS BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} ORDER BY POS ASC
